verdict.rationale: Aircall's own marketing says calls, SMS and messaging stay connected to your CRM, and that AI Assistants update CRM records automatically. Both are high-level claims with no detail on how logging or contact matching works. The webhook and API tutorials are developer building blocks and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented automatic call and SMS logging behavior, matching of activities to the right CRM contact, named CRM integrations with setup docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, calls and texts log to my CRM automatically against the right contact

citations.quote: Calls, SMS, and messaging live in one platform, keeping every interaction connected to your CRM, help desk, and business tools.
AI Assistants capture notes, update CRM records, and create follow-up tasks automatically
logging the outcome in your CRM
